title: Remove the items of cancelled orders
prompt: Delete every row of order_items that belongs to a cancelled order. Leave the orders themselves, and the items of all other orders, in place.
hints: order_items has no status. Where is the status of an order stored?
A subquery can list the ids of the cancelled orders.
DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled');
verify: SELECT count(*) AS items, count(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_with_items, (SELECT count(*) FROM orders) AS orders FROM order_items;

wrongAnswers.misconception: Leaves out the WHERE and deletes every item.
Deletes the items of every order that is not delivered.

feedback: Run the subquery on its own first. It should list only the cancelled orders.
